description: Portable patterns from claw-code-parity Rust implementation to enhance the Nexus A2A Protocol

patterns.name: Hook Pipeline → 13-Point Route Admission
patterns.source_pattern: HookRunner with pre/post tool-use hooks. Hooks execute as shell commands with JSON stdin, environment variables (HOOK_EVENT, HOOK_TOOL_NAME, etc.), exit-code signaling (0=allow, 2=deny). Supports HookAbortSignal for cancellation and HookProgressReporter for observability.
patterns.adaptation: Each of 13 admission check points becomes an independent hook. Checks: (1) record status, (2) agent name validity, (3) namespace delegation, (4) trust anchors, (5) JWKS URI format, (6) thumbprint policy, (7) certificate-bound tokens, (8) policy tags, (9) jurisdiction/data-residency, (10) federated trust anchors, (11) protocol version, (12) feature flags, (13) transport endpoint reachability.

patterns.name: ConversationRuntime → A2A Task Execution
patterns.source_pattern: ConversationRuntime<C, T> with generic ApiClient and ToolExecutor traits. Loop: Request→Stream→Parse→Execute Tools→Record Results→Loop. Features auto-compaction at token threshold, usage tracking, session tracing.
patterns.adaptation: Map to A2A task lifecycle: Accept→Checkpoint→Complete/Escalate→Reject. Each tool execution runs through admission hooks. Checkpoints are persisted via JSONL sessions. Auto-compaction preserves clinical context within token limits.

patterns.name: Subprocess Extension → Clinical Agent Isolation
patterns.source_pattern: Plugins execute as subprocess commands with JSON I/O. Environment variables expose context (CLAWD_PLUGIN_ID, CLAWD_TOOL_NAME, CLAWD_TOOL_INPUT). Exit codes signal success/failure.
patterns.adaptation: Each of 25 clinical agents runs as isolated subprocess. Receives FHIR payload via stdin JSON, returns structured result via stdout JSON. Environment variables: AGENT_ID, TASK_ID, PATIENT_CONTEXT_HASH.

patterns.name: Session Management → Clinical Audit Trail
patterns.source_pattern: JSONL-persisted sessions with rotation after 256KB. Tracks version, session_id, timestamps, message blocks, compaction history, fork lineage (parent tracking). Immutable message appending with atomic file writes.
patterns.adaptation: A2A exchanges persisted as JSONL session records. Fork lineage enables clinical conversation chain auditing. Add hash-chaining for tamper evidence (new requirement for healthcare compliance).

patterns.name: Provider Abstraction → Multi-LLM Agent Backends
patterns.source_pattern: ProviderClient enum (Anthropic/xAI/OpenAI) via common Provider trait. Model aliasing (opus→claude-opus-4-6, grok→grok-3). Per-provider auth env vars and base URL overrides.
patterns.adaptation: Generalize to Bevan/Claude/GPT-5.4/DeepSeek per-agent configuration. Data-residency rules force Bevan for patient data. Failover configurable per agent.
